name: Elune's Grace: a critical Hand of Elune raises the target's armor (#7526)
contract: Elune's Grace 504001 reads 'Critical heals with Hand of Elune now increase the target's armor by $504027s1% for $504027d'. 504027 is MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT (101) on physical resistance with 9 base points (+10%) and a 15 s duration. aura_ascension_starcaller_event::Check accepts the proc only when the hit is critical and Hand of Elune 801990 healed for a non-zero effective amount, then Proc casts 504027 on the healed ally. spell_crit_rating 100000 makes every Hand of Elune critical. The first cast heals an injured ally, the second one a full-health ally so the whole heal is overheal.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Elune's Grace passive is active
SETUP: no armor buff before any heal
SETUP: Hand of Elune crit-healed the injured ally
CASE A (injured ally): the critical heal applies the armor buff 504027
SETUP: Hand of Elune crit-healed the full-health ally
CASE B (full-health ally): the critical heal applies the armor buff 504027
